fact: UNDP Malawi reports on 27 February 2025 that Mwanza District Council uses the locally developed LORMIS, with an Android app for market tickets, parking and border entry fees plus business registration, on which every transaction is traceable, with all components in use in Mwanza, developed by the council's systems analyst with UNDP support.
title: Digital Tool Improves How Mwanza Collects Revenue
